text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Woof, woof. Falco-san, happy birthday to 
you. Woof~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Woof, woof. I am Woof-Woof Accolade. And 
I'm a huge fan of yours, Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's Trancend... nya. Accu-wan invited me, 
so I dashed on over, nya~. I'm gonna 
celebrate with all my might, nya~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you both...? But why are you 
dressed like a dog and a cat!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to try cheering in a different 
way, you see~ You did say you wanted all 
kinds of people to become your fans, 
right, Falco-san?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, that's how I wracked my brain a 
bit. Never thought I'd end up having to do 
it too, though~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a twist, huh?! Still, Falco's 
super happy♪ Maybe I should sing a song to 
return the celebration!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To all my furry dog and cat friends~! 
Thank you so much for the sweet wishes~! 
Tha~nk! Yo~u! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Heave-ho, heaaaave-ho, woof♪ Ah, 
heave-ho, heaaaave-ho, woof♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, what a lovely call-and-response... 
call-and-paw-sponse!\nHeave-ho☆ Woof, 
woof☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Tran-san, you too! Alright, 
heave-ho☆ Meow, meow?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I was recording because I thought it'd be 
super cute, but... haha. Guess I'll have 
to edit out my own voice, meow~...)
